{{Term/Store|Mountain Crow|Mountain Crows|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Mountain Crow'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Mountain Crow'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Mountain Crow}}
Mountain Crows are a species of [[Bird]] that can be found on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and in the [[Great Hyrule Forest]]. Despite their name, Mountain Crows, can also be found in forests and villagers.<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite|This bird is known for its cleverness and for its distinct claws. They make their homes in mountains, forests, and villages alike. Not only are their jet-black feathers seen as an ill omen, but they'll steal the crops right out of a farmer's hands if given the chance. Because of this, they're often met with enmity. |Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> They are noted for their advanced intelligence and distinct claws.<ref name="Compendium"/> They are often hated due to their feathers being seen as ill omens, and they are known to steal crops from farmers.<ref name="Compendium"/> If Mountain Crows are killed, they drop a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Mountain Crow}}
Several Mountain Crows can be seen on top of the fountain in the [[Central Square]] of the [[Hyrule Castle Town Ruins]].
